title: Does the safety vector survive the quantization link that consumer deployment requires?

original_idea.body: Extract refusal direction at full precision; apply to 8-bit/4-bit quantized model and measure effectiveness drop, plus whether re-extraction recovers it; consumer-GPU friendly.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: quantization silently breaking safety steering is a concrete widespread open-weight gap (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract vector + compare across precisions with standard tooling; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (effectiveness-vs-precision table) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Consumer-quantized deployment is lab-deprioritized; neglected open-weight safety work (level 5).

low_compute.reasoning: Quantized inference is consumer-GPU friendly, no training.

novelty.reasoning: Quantization-specific steering robustness appears mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Quantization-specific steering robustness appears mostly novel.
